answer: A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The nectar counter is kept in jade and relic reveals each reset. An adversary thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2067 identities would post 3993 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
